selected.prompt: Edit this single Chinese barracks sprite with ONE proportion correction. Extend the rectangular wall, upright columns and the two wooden door leaves DOWNWARD by 25 percent of the current door's clear height. Move the complete stone footing and doorstep downward with them. The door top/lintel and roof eave stay exactly fixed. Do not raise the lintel into roof tiles. Preserve every horizontal dimension, including total foundation width, door width and the two lattice window widths. Preserve the entire charcoal tiled Chinese roof exactly: same height, depth, horizontal ridge, modest curved eaves, and ornaments. Windows remain their current dimensions; the new plaster area is below them. If necessary extend the transparent canvas below the house rather than shrinking the whole sprite. This is a normal one-storey Chinese barracks with a correctly human-sized door, not a tall tower. No other objects or changes; true transparent alpha.

Create ONE west-facing Chinese barracks dormitory sprite by editing the first image. The first image is the game's calibrated west-facing 3x2 military dormitory: retain its narrow gable-facing camera angle, rectangular stone foundation width and depth, upright one-storey wall proportions, and tall human-sized wooden door visible along the LEFT side. The second image is the approved SOUTH facade of this same Chinese dormitory and supplies the design, not the camera. Replace orange European tiles with the identical charcoal gray Chinese tiled roof, modest curved eaves and restrained upturned ridge ornaments. Match its warm wood columns, white plaster, lattice windows and pale stone footing. Keep the visible gable-end window centered. The long facade with its door is along the LEFT edge; do not put a door on the gable end. The door clear height divided by the visible stone-foundation horizontal span should be at least 0.34, a normal usable adult doorway, not a tiny slit. Preserve exactly one building and its orientation; do not show a compound, walls, scenery, text, people, shadows on background, or separate items. Full building visible with generous margin, true transparent alpha. No background or halo.

Edit the first sprite into the NORTH/rear view of the Chinese barracks dormitory shown in the second sprite. Keep the first image's straight rear-facing broad 3x2 one-storey dormitory camera, stone foundation span, upright wall height, four evenly spaced rear windows and timber posts. No rear door: the entrance is hidden on the opposite long facade. Match the second image's charcoal-gray Chinese rounded roof tiles, horizontal ridge, modest curved eaves with restrained upturned ends, warm timber, cream plaster, wooden lattice windows and pale gray footing. Roof and wall belong to the same normal low Chinese house as the approved south reference, not a tower or temple. Keep the entire building unclipped. Remove all European tile/color cues. One building only, no scenery, people, signs, flags, shadows, background haze or glow. True transparent alpha background.

Edit the first game sprite into the EAST view of the approved Chinese barracks dormitory in the second image. Keep the first image's narrow gable-facing orthographic camera, foundation span and depth, upright single-storey wall height and human door on the RIGHT side facade. The gable end remains a lattice window and has no doorway. Match the second image's charcoal Chinese roof tiles, restrained upturned eaves and ridge ends, warm orange-brown timber posts, cream plaster, wooden lattice windows and pale stone footing. Use the same building design, correctly turned to EAST. Preserve the doorway's tall usable clear opening and doorstep; do not shrink wall/door to enlarge roof. No chimney, labels, flags, scenery, courtyard, other buildings or person. Full sprite with safe transparent margin and genuinely transparent background; no background gradient or colored glow.

Edit the FIRST sprite into a compact SOUTH-facing Chinese military headquarters house. Keep the first image's square 2x2 stone foundation footprint, narrow gable-facing camera, single-storey upright wall height, centered full-size single wooden doorway and doorstep. Change only architecture and materials to match the SECOND image's approved Chinese barracks: charcoal-gray Chinese rounded roof tiles, restrained upturned ridge ornaments and curved eaves, warm wood posts, cream plaster and pale stone base. Remove the European chimney entirely. Replace European cross-braces with simple Chinese timber framing. This is a smaller square headquarters house, distinct from the wide 3x2 dormitory shown in reference two. Preserve the first source's tall usable adult door and relative door-to-foundation width/height; a door about 55 percent of the projected foundation horizontal span in clear height. Keep low ordinary one-storey roof and normal house proportions; no giant temple roof or tower. One complete unclipped building, no text, person, flag, courtyard, backdrop, ground shadow or glow. True transparent alpha with empty margins.

Make ONE localized doorway proportion correction to this WEST-facing Chinese headquarters sprite. Keep the stone footprint, camera, entire roof, plain front-facing wall, all canvas dimensions and every horizontal size unchanged. Only the visible wooden door on the LEFT side is too short. Raise its top/lintel UPWARD by roughly 120 source pixels (from around y690 to around y570 near x220 in this 1073x1466 image), lengthening the two wooden door leaves upward. The sill, doorstep and bottom of door stay at exactly their current positions. Remove or raise the small diagonal decorative beam just above that doorway as needed to open the existing left-side plaster wall area. The raised doorway must end within the plaster/timber wall, never enter any roof tile. Its clear height becomes roughly 520 pixels measured at the same x on the side facade, suitable for a normal adult. Keep the roof/eaves exactly where they are and don't shrink the whole sprite or inflate the foundation. Everything else unchanged. True transparent alpha.

Edit the FIRST sprite into the NORTH/rear view of the Chinese military headquarters shown in the SECOND sprite. Keep the first image's square 2x2 stone foundation footprint, upright single-storey rear-facing gable camera and exact normal wall height. Copy the second's charcoal Chinese curved tile roof, restrained upturned eaves, simple warm timber posts and cream plaster, and pale stone footing. Completely remove the chimney and European timber cross-bracing. The doorway is hidden on the opposite SOUTH facade: this rear must have NO doorway or doorstep, and it may have one small centered traditional lattice window. Same modest one-storey square house, never a temple or tower. Full building, unclipped, with clean empty margins. Transparent alpha only; no glow, gradient, background, scenery, people, sign or flag.

Fix only canvas clearance for this exact Chinese headquarters EAST sprite. Its far-right stone doorstep touches/cuts at the image boundary. Expand transparent margin on the right and around the entire building so ALL of the stone footing, doorstep, roof and tips are fully inside the canvas with at least 40 empty pixels on all four sides. Continue the missing rightmost stone step edge naturally if necessary. Preserve the identical one-storey building, charcoal Chinese tiled roof, timber/plaster, camera direction, full-height right-side door, all colors, all relative geometry and the door-to-foundation proportion. Do not change the building design or stretch it. True transparent background only, no glow, added object or shadow.
